== English Coruscant Effect comparison ==
The Players Committee added the Grabber icon to the Coruscant Effect. The rulebook lists the change in July 2007, and the later Effect slip and Appendix confirm it. The game text and the remaining printed fields agree. The Reflections III Defensive Shield has a separate Appendix A entry.

[[:File:Cor-L-atragedyhasoccurred-decipher-archive.jpg|Printed Coruscant Effect]]. Decipher, [https://archive.org/details/youtube-oDR3IRuAbhI Radio Free Decipher #90], 3 August 2001, 0:34, and [https://archive.org/details/youtube-BLjrDT1fFms #91], 10 August 2001, 0:58, confirm release on 8 August 2001. Players Committee, [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=93 Advanced Rulebook 1.7.1], Icons – Grabbers, July 2007, PDF page 93. [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=21 Coruscant Effect slip], 2017 compilation, PDF page 21. [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=102 Advanced Rulebook 2023], Appendix A, PDF page 102, Coruscant Effect entry.
